target.title: feat(skills): preview proposals before approval
target.body:
Closes #103871

## Summary

- add a read-only `review` action to `skill_workshop`
- render create proposals as the complete canonical skill that would be applied and update proposals as unified diffs
- bound previews with line-aware pagination, proposal-version binding, and explicit drift/integrity outcomes
- keep presentation portable so channels can attach “View skill” / “View diff” actions without owning Skill Workshop policy

## Problem

Approval messages currently provide only a prose summary. Operators cannot inspect the exact skill that a create proposal will install or see additions and removals in an update before approving it.

## Design and safety

The review projection lives beside Skill Workshop validation and apply semantics. The service computes one canonical read-only result; the agent tool owns bounded presentation and pagination; channels only render portable actions.

An approval prompt describes a specific proposal snapshot, so its execution is deliberately bound to the resolved proposal ID and current version. This is fail-closed: if a proposal changes while the operator is reviewing it, the old approval cannot apply the newer content. A code-site invariant now documents this coupling. Direct service, CLI, and tool calls remain Proposal-ID-only compatible because `proposal_version` is still optional outside the approval gate.

## User impact

- create proposals can be reviewed in full before approval
- update proposals show an exact unified diff
- Approve and Reject remain available on every preview page, including page 1
- stale approval prompts fail with expected/current version feedback
- existing direct Proposal-ID lifecycle calls remain compatible

## Evidence

- 239 focused Vitest tests pass on final head `d5c1be51d406858d447fa97658ca72bdb1ad8872`.
- Production and test tsgo checks pass.
- Exact changed-file oxlint and oxfmt checks, plus `git diff --check`, pass.
- Repeated structured autoreview found and fixed approval-parameter preservation, caught the TOCTOU risk in an attempted alternative, and reported the final branch and final formatting fix clean with no accepted/actionable findings.
- A redacted live Telegram recording covers create/update review, pagination, first-page lifecycle controls, approval/rejection, and stale-version rejection. GIF, contact sheet, and full recording are included below.
- The broad remote `pnpm check:changed` lane could not start from this host because the configured Blacksmith client is absent. GitHub CI remains the broad remote gate.

## Verification

```bash
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs \
  src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.test.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.test.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts \
  src/agents/agent-tools.before-tool-call.embedded-mode.test.ts

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental \
  --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental \
  --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  src/agents/skill-workshop-prompt.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.ts \
  src/agents/tool-catalog.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.test.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.test.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.ts \
  src/cli/skills-cli.ts \
  src/cli/skills-cli.workshop.test.ts \
  src/skills/lifecycle/workspace-skill-write.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/service.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/store.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/types.ts

pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 \
  docs/cli/skills.md \
  docs/tools/skill-workshop.md \
  src/agents/skill-workshop-prompt.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts \
  src/agents/system-prompt.ts \
  src/agents/tool-catalog.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.test.ts \
  src/agents/tool-mutation.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.test.ts \
  src/agents/tools/skill-workshop-tool.ts \
  src/cli/skills-cli.ts \
  src/cli/skills-cli.workshop.test.ts \
  src/skills/lifecycle/workspace-skill-write.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/policy.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/service.test.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/service.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/store.ts \
  src/skills/workshop/types.ts

git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main
```

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: preview the exact canonical result of a Skill Workshop proposal before approval and bind the later lifecycle decision to that reviewed version.

Real environment tested: live Telegram DM on deployed production integration `ef2acbbe69b52f92c788188de3b159de92ad24ef`. The production branch was subsequently refreshed to `d06a05135e6103c22c1eaf677b89ddb93217ea08`; the final two PR commits only document the existing version-binding invariant and apply formatter-required whitespace, without changing runtime behavior.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: review a paginated create proposal and its first-page Approve/Reject/Next controls; revise v1 to v2 and attempt approval from the stale v1 prompt; review and approve the fresh v2 prompt; review an update proposal's unified diff and reject it.

Evidence after fix:

![Telegram Skill Workshop review proof](https://f005.backblazeb2.com/file/Hetzner-Openclaw/pr-artifacts/openclaw-103872/visual-e76915ff/pr-103872-telegram-proof.gif?Authorization=3_20260711140824_d089acaacb6df5b260e61a32_834b1e1b00e93314452bbe02924ae004a1d0cb64_005_20260718140824_0073_dnld)

- [six-frame contact sheet](https://f005.backblazeb2.com/file/Hetzner-Openclaw/pr-artifacts/openclaw-103872/visual-e76915ff/pr-103872-telegram-proof-contact-sheet.png?Authorization=3_20260711140826_b341cd7480bacb59906b35a4_313403104b89ee2edc6c83470e8299b9315e32bc_005_20260718140826_0087_dnld) — SHA-256 `7312d9b8256bd5e43b6c182efd12f9322e8f2584014fe23142d0bfb442c0b3cb`
- [full redacted H.264 recording](https://f005.backblazeb2.com/file/Hetzner-Openclaw/pr-artifacts/openclaw-103872/87a5fbc3/1691a798/pr-103872-telegram-proof.mp4?Authorization=3_20260711090657_c2ed04244ad7b5248a3e644a_2539c27da42238cee21c9519b915add2b4ae651b_005_20260718090657_0075_dnld) — 71.37 seconds, SHA-256 `1691a798025c9ffa45bd8ffd6b91980079dcf23d069bdc5b598adb6f93727da5`

The temporary proof links are valid through 2026-07-18. GIF SHA-256: `e76915ffcc3cb17f516d7fedd8812ba83d6ff03b2ab0f663d41c9f36983845ec`.

Observed result after fix: create approval succeeds only for the reviewed current version; stale approval fails closed with expected-v1/current-v2 feedback; update review shows the unified diff; Approve and Reject remain available from page 1.

What was not tested: a separate burner-account Crabbox run. The behavior was instead exercised end-to-end in the deployed production integration used by the operator.

## AI assistance

AI-assisted: yes. Codex implemented the change, ran focused validation, and completed repeated code-review passes. No agent transcript is attached.
